data.message: I commit to 18 tons and propose individual opt-ins, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each other fisher: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain, then500 or100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; intentions aren't enforceable. Other catches need recalculation; 18 isn't guaranteed best long-run.
